# Daily Dashboard V0.5.13

The weather widget now advances to the new day at midnight in the forecast location's time zone. It refreshes the forecast, resets day navigation to today, and updates the hourly graph, daily metrics, sunrise/sunset and five-day list without restarting Dashboard.

- Handles daylight-saving changes and year boundaries.
- Catches up after sleep or a change in the system clock, including while the weather widget is hidden.
- Uses the new day's cached daily forecast while refreshing. Yesterday's current readings are not labelled as fresh conditions.
- Retries failed or outdated forecast responses after one minute and retries when connectivity returns.
- Supports Windows and macOS. Existing settings and monitor bindings are preserved.

Install over the existing version, or use the updater in Settings → Updates.
